properties.digitized_from: OpenStreetMap (way 1258086102, addr:housename=Radiance at Mission Bay, 325 China Basin St)
properties.digitization_method: ADDED 2026-09-18 for Mission Bay's second real-site pass: real, address-tagged OpenStreetMap building footprint for Radiance, a 99-unit, 9-story Bosa Development condominium tower at 325 China Basin St/330 Mission Bay Blvd N, completed circa 2008-2009, notable as one of the first major US condo developments to open after the 2008 financial crisis. Shares Assessor Block 8720 with its sister project Madrone. Point-in-polygon checked against DataSF's official redevelopment-area layer: this site falls in Mission Bay South, not Mission Bay North as this project's own brief informally grouped it.
properties.accuracy_caveat: REAL -- surveyed OpenStreetMap building footprint(s), not a hand trace or plan estimate. The underlying Assessor parcel is condo-mapped across many individually owned per-unit lots (confirmed against data/raw/parcels.geojson), so no single blklot represents the whole building and it cannot be joined via status.csv the way a single-owner parcel can. Using the real building footprint from OSM instead of a fabricated or arbitrarily chosen 'representative' unit lot, the same real-geometry-without-a-single-parcel pattern already used for several Pier 70 buildings (DataSF Building Footprints) and for Mission Bay's own real park polygons.
properties.notes: Story count is reported as 9 by two independent realtor sources; one outlier source says 16, which appears to conflate Radiance with the taller sister building Madrone -- not used here.
